messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's definitely the cause. MMS requires at least a 3G network connection, and 2G networks are generally not suitable for MMS. Your phone is currently set to "2g_only", which prevents MMS from working.

Please run this on your phone: **set_network_mode_preference(mode="4g_5g_preferred")**

This will allow your phone to connect to faster networks (4G/5G) which are required for MMS. After you do that, let me know when it's done.

I have set the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred as you instructed. What should I do now? Should I try sending an MMS message again?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
